State `{ lastMs: -1, counter }`, `ms = clock.now().getTime()`: if `ms > lastMs` then `lastMs = ms`, `counter = 0`, else `counter += 1`, and past `0xfff` `lastMs += 1`, `counter = 0`; `lastMs` is written. The prefix matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9]{0,15}$`. `sequentialIds(seed = 0)` returns `${prefix}_00000000-0000-7000-8000-<counter, 12 hex>`, first counter `seed` (integer 0 to `0xffffffffffff`, else `RangeError`, also on overflow)
